org: Kasser Joint Institute for Food, Water and Energy Security (Jewish National Fund-USA)
program_hint: Large Scale Agrivoltaics (Southern Arava R&D with University of Arizona, from January 2026) and Makueni agrivoltaics, Kenya
why: It already runs agrivoltaics research in Israel and Kenya, including a 2026 project with the University of Arizona, so SALSAV should ask how that work is funded and whether it can extend or open a partner window.

org: Transforming Energy Access (TEA), FCDO Ayrton Fund, delivered by Carbon Trust
program_hint: Open calls, technology accelerators and foundational research and training
why: UK-funded platform for clean energy innovation and productive use of energy in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia, with a 2026 scale-up announced and calls posted through the year; check whether US universities can partner or lead research work.

org: Efficiency for Access Research and Development Fund (managed by Energy Saving Trust)
program_hint: Agritech Advance (2026) and earlier Agritech Call
why: Funds clean energy agricultural technology and field performance research for smallholders in off-grid Sub-Saharan Africa, with earlier grants of about GBP 50,000 to 300,000; the 2026 cohort is already named, so look for the next call and a research-validation partner role.

program_hint: Call for Projects (annual cycle; 2026 call up to EUR 25 million per project)
why: Grant-based climate finance for energy-sector mitigation projects in OECD aid-eligible countries (including Mexico and Kenya) open to any legal entity; SALSAV would need an implementing partner and an agrivoltaics-as-energy framing, and the 2026 concept phase has closed so watch the next call.

program_hint: Annual Food Planet Prize (2026: USD 1.5 million winner, USD 150,000 per finalist)
why: Annual prize for food-system projects that reduce environmental harm and are likely to scale; dual-use agrivoltaics scaling work could be nominated, and the 2027 longlist is already out so the next nomination window is the one to watch.

program_hint: Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity (EUR 1 million, climate action, by nomination)
why: Annual EUR 1 million prize for climate action open to individuals and organisations worldwide by nomination; SALSAV's agrivoltaics scaling across Arizona, Mexico, Kenya and Israel is a plausible nominee once it has measured impact.

program_hint: Collaborative Research Actions (next: Arctic 3 and Biodiversity 3, expected 2027)
why: Multi-country transdisciplinary environmental research calls in which NSF can fund US teams; current and planned calls are not on agriculture or energy, so this is a watch item for a future food, water or resilience call.

org: Inter-American Institute for Global Change Research (IAI)
program_hint: Research projects, seed grants and Belmont Forum co-led calls
why: Intergovernmental institute of which the US is a member that funds interdisciplinary global-change research and capacity building across the Americas, including Mexico; award sizes and any open call still need checking.
